items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: I think one of them fellas started out there was a fella by name of Patterson... I didn't keep up too much with him. But I remember he used to come around and see me around the store all the time.

ctx.x: And who was your, did any of those pupils ever become famous? From the Morris Music School?

Well I think one of them fellas started out there was a fella by name of Patterson, became a fine saxophone, but I guess there were others, I didn't keep up too much with him. But I remember he used to come around and see me around the store all the time. He played great. All the guys used to go, he was playing in some dance hall around Royal Street somewhere, and all the white guys used to go around and listen to him play, played great. John Patterson I think his name was. His dad had a hotel up on Ramport…
